Hi Sofia,

Thanks for your patience, and sorry about this. Your $29.99 payment went through and your monthly Premium subscription is active. A temporary glitch on our side stopped Premium from being switched on for your account after you paid.

We've set up the fix to turn on Premium for your account using that payment. A support team member will approve it shortly. Once it's done, your lessons will unlock. If they still look locked, try signing out and back in or refreshing the page.

You won't be charged again. If anything still looks wrong after that, just reply here and we'll take care of it.

Best,
PawPlan Support
